svg.aria-label: Dot plot of paired tokens-per-joule ratios, candidate over base, on an axis from 1.00 to 1.07 with a dashed promotion bar at 1.03. Round 1 against stock: screening run 1.0539, hollow and not counted; pairs 1.0569, 1.0564, 1.0573, 1.0564 and 1.0587; mean 1.0572, 95 percent interval 1.0560 to 1.0583, promoted. Round 2 against round 1: screening run 1.0235, not counted; pairs 1.0286, 1.0276, 1.0281, 1.0266 and 1.0270; mean 1.0276, interval 1.0266 to 1.0286, under the bar, not promoted.
